objectives: Describe Joseph making himself known to his brethren.
Explain how God meant the evil unto good.
Identify the attributes of Joseph to apply in trials.
takeaways: Joseph's brethren did not know him: he was grown, and clothed in the customs of Egypt.
It was not you that sent me hither, but God, to preserve life by a great deliverance.
Joseph kept the law of forgiveness: not seven times, but seventy times seven.
The word of the Lord tried him, and the Lord caused the enemy to entreat him well.
Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof; if thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
